login.heading: Choose your role for today
login.lede: This page <1>chooses a role</1> for the prototype. It secures nothing: the demo codes are printed below and stored as they are. Enterprise-grade access enforcement is recorded as a production requirement, not a feature that has been built.
login.category: CATEGORY 2: RISK EFFICIENCY AT HEALTH FACILITIES
login.footnote: Columns marked <1>No</1> are refused by the server with a stable error code; hiding a button is not access control. The full matrix is in ADR-0006 § 2. A functional prototype from a participating team, <3>not an official BPJS Kesehatan product or service.</3>

matrix.caption: Sample accounts and what each role may do. Choose a row to sign in as that person.

signIn.incomplete: Fill in the email and the demo code first.
signIn.editable: Both fields stay editable. The rows above are only a shortcut.
